Download App Get Started for Free

The Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU), on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE), is all set to announce the AP EAMCET Result 2026 on 18th June 2026 at its official website. The results will be declared in the form of an online PDF. Once released, all those candidates who appeared for the 2026 Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture, and Medical Common Entrance Test between 12th May and 20th May 2026 will be able to check and download their online scorecards by simply visiting the official website cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET and logging in using their respective application number and password/date of birth as login credentials. They will also be able to access the same through the direct link shared in the article below.

AP EAMCET Results 2026

The Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture, and Medical Common Entrance Test conducted by the Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU) on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) and serves as the mandatory state-level entrance exam for students seeking undergraduate admissions into professional courses across Andhra Pradesh. Soon after the completion of the AP EAPCET examination, candidates were eagerly waiting for the outcomes of their hard work. So this is to inform them that their wait is finally over as the AP EAPCET results arre scheduled to be announced on 18th June 2026. Candidates must make sure they check the detailed result PDF carefully and start preparing for the next stage.

AP EAPCET Results 2026 PDF Download Link

The Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU) on behalf of the APSCHE is all set to activated official window to check and download the AP EAPCET 2026 Result PDF on 18th June 2026 at its official portal. The result comprises all important details from the candidate’s personal information to scored marks, pass/fail status and much more. Once the scorecards are issued, candidates are advised to check and download them as soon as possible either through the official EAPCET website or by simply clicking on the direct link that will soon be shared here.

How to Check AP EAPCET Result 2026 at cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET?

The process to check and download AP EAPCETT Result 2026 PDF is simple, just visit the official website and follow the detailed step-by-step process shared here.

Step 1: Firstly, go to official AP EAMCET website, i.e., cets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET.

Step 2: Look for “Latest updates” section displayed on top of EAPCET homepage.

Step 3: Now search for “AP EAPCET Result 2026” PDF download link.

Step 4: Page will be redirected to login window.

Step 5: Carefully fill out your respective login details, such as application number and password/date of birth.

Step 6. Enter the security pin and click on submit button.

Step 7: Check all the details mentioned on AP EAPCET Result 2026 PDF, and if any error is found, get it rectified as soon as possible.

Step 8: At the end, do not forget to download the AP EAMCET Result PDF and keep it safe for future use.

What Details are Mentioned on AP EAPCET Result 2026 PDF?

After downloading the AP EAPCET Result 2026, candidates must make sure to check all the details mentioned on it. If any error is found, make sure to get it rectified as soon as possible. Some of the details mentioned on the AP EAPCET Result 2026 have also been discussed here.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Date pof Birth
  • Guardian’s Name
  • Course applied for
  • Signature and Stamp of APSCHE
  • Category
  • Gender
  • Name of Examination
  • Scored Marks
  • Pass/Fail Status
  • Details regarding the next stage

AP EAMCET Counselling Process 2026 

The AP EAMCET counselling process is the next step after the successful announcement of the results. As of now the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) has not yet announced any counselling dates, but they are expected to be held in the month of July 2026. The process includes many different stages ranging from completing online registration to pay a processing fee, verifying certificates, filling out college and course preferences (web options), and accepting their seat allotment. It is to be noted that for AP EAPCET counselling process, candidates are required to pay a fixed amount, i.e., ₹1,200 for OC/BC candidates and ₹600 for SC/ST.

AP EAPCET Result 2026 FAQs

Is AP EAPCET Result 2026 announced?

Answer: No, AP EAMCET Result 2026 is not yet announced, but is scheduled to be declared on 18th June 2026

What is the next step after AP EAPCET Result 2026 is announced?

Answer: After the announcement of Tamil Nadu PSC CTS Result 2026, candidates are advised to start preparing for next round, i.e., the counselling stage.

What is official website to check AP EAMCET Result 2026?

Answer: The official Andhra Pradesh EAPCET Result 2026 PDF download link has been activated atcets.apsche.ap.gov.in/EAPCET.

Will I require any login details to access my AP EAPCET scorecards?

Answer: No, candidates are not required to enter any login details to access their online AP EAMCET Scorecard 2026.
